topic: Supervisory status, FSI, Senior Maintenance Rating – scope area of responsibilities w.r.t supervisory checks, independent check and flight servicing

specific_objectives: 1.1.1.2 Trainee will be able to understand the qualification of responsibilities and promotion regulations.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list

practical: Review of maintenance order signatures and verification of FSI status on aircraft logbooks.
intro_questions: What is the primary responsibility of a Senior Maintenance Rating?
Define the term Flight Servicing in the context of maintenance.
Who is authorized to sign off on an Independent Check?

development.content:
Supervisory status and hierarchy
FSI definition and application
Senior Maintenance Rating qualifications
Promotion regulations overview
Scope of supervisory responsibilities

Supervisory checks procedures
Independent check requirements
Flight servicing scope and limits
Documentation for checks
Delegation of authority

Review of qualification criteria
Distinction between check types
Regulatory compliance for ratings
Case study analysis
Summary of key responsibilities

summary_questions: Explain the difference between a supervisory check and an independent check.
Under what conditions can a Senior Maintenance Rating authorize flight servicing?
How does the FSI status impact the scope of maintenance responsibilities?
